title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a finalised agreement that establishes shared principles and commitments for responsible AI development, deployment, and governance among its signatories. It sets out standards for transparency, accountability, safety, and collaboration to help ensure AI technologies benefit society while mitigating potential risks.
